description: Get the tonal distribution of articles matching a query as a histogram (bins approximately -30 to +30). Unlike a single average tone score, the histogram reveals whether coverage is uniformly negative, bimodal (some articles extremely positive and some extremely negative), or clustered near neutral. Each bin carries its first 3 representative article links and referenceCount, how many GDELT returned; name bins in the bins input to get only those bins, each with every link. A response carries limit bins (default 10, cap 400); when more remain it returns nextOffset — pass it back as offset with otherwise identical inputs for the next page. Distinct from gdelt_get_coverage_timeline (mode: tone) — this is a snapshot distribution across all matching articles, not a time series. Use gdelt_get_coverage_timeline with mode "tone" to see how sentiment shifted over time.

bins.description: Tone bins to return alone, e.g. [-7, 4]. Take them from histogram[].bin in a prior response, or from the list an unknown_bin error prints. The response then carries only these bins, in histogram order, each with every representative article link instead of the first 3. A value matching no bin is rejected rather than silently ignored.

endDatetime.description: End datetime in GDELT format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS — exactly 14 digits, no separators (e.g. 20240131235959). Must pair with startDatetime; supplying only one of the two is rejected. The window may predate the last 3 months.

limit.description: Maximum bins per page (default 10, cap 400). Larger counts clamp to 400 unless GDELT_CLAMP_LIMITS=false.

offset.description: Zero-based bin offset — into the histogram, or into the bins named in bins. Pass nextOffset from the preceding response, with otherwise identical inputs, to get the next page.

query.description: Search query using GDELT syntax. Same operators as gdelt_search_articles: phrases, boolean OR, sourcecountry:, sourcelang:, domain:, theme: (GKG theme identifiers come from gdelt_search_themes).

startDatetime.description: Start datetime in GDELT format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS — exactly 14 digits, no separators (e.g. 20240101000000). Must pair with endDatetime; supplying only one of the two is rejected. The window may predate the last 3 months.

timespan.description: Time window relative to now, minimum "15min"; other examples: "24h", "7d", "1m". Ignored when startDatetime/endDatetime are set. Maximum 3 months.

name: gdelt_get_tone_distribution

attempts.description: Each source tried for this call, in order. Present only when the DOC API did not answer with data and the mirror was consulted.

items.description: One source's outcome for this call.

detail.description: Why, when the outcome has a reason: DOC's failure message or the mirror's.

outcome.description: What the source did: answered, empty (answered with no matches), rate_limited, or unavailable; or why the mirror could not answer: not_ready (no completed sync), not_compiled (the query or its timespan is in a form the mirror cannot evaluate), outside_coverage (the window lies outside the days it holds), store_error.

coverage.description: Present only when the mirror answered less than the requested window. Every count, share, and article in this response comes from answeredStart through answeredEnd; nothing outside it, or in a missing slot, was counted.

answeredEnd.description: End of the window the mirror answered, ISO 8601 UTC.

answeredStart.description: Start of the window the mirror answered, ISO 8601 UTC.

missingSlots.description: 15-minute GKG slots inside the answered window that the mirror holds no data for.

requestedEnd.description: End of the requested window, ISO 8601 UTC.

requestedStart.description: Start of the requested window, ISO 8601 UTC.

effectiveQuery.description: Echoed query string for use in follow-up calls.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_bin`: A value passed in the bins input matches no bin in a non-empty histogram. `offset_out_of_range`: The requested offset is at or beyond the last bin of a non-empty histogram, or of the bins named in bins. `invalid_date_range`: Only one of startDatetime / endDatetime was supplied, one of them is not a real UTC calendar timestamp, or startDatetime is not earlier than endDatetime. `invalid_query`: GDELT rejected the query string as malformed — bad keyword length, unbalanced parentheses, or an illegal character. `gdelt_rate_limited`: GDELT rejected the request for its one-request-per-five-seconds limit, or too many requests were already queued for this one to start in time. `gdelt_unavailable`: GDELT DOC API is unreachable or temporarily returned no usable data. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

histogram.description: The bins of this page, sorted from most negative to most positive — the whole histogram when it fits.

items.description: A single tone histogram bin with article count and representative articles.

articles.description: Representative articles in this tone bin — the first 3, or all of them for a bin named in bins.

items.description: A representative article for this tone bin.

bin.description: Tone bin integer (typically -30 to +30; 0 is neutral).

count.description: Number of articles in this bin.

referenceCount.description: How many representative articles GDELT returned for this bin; articles carries the first 3 unless the bin was named in bins.

limitClamp.description: Present only when the requested count exceeded the per-call cap: the call ran exactly as a call at the cap, and every count, notice, and continuation in this response reflects the applied value.

applied.description: The per-call cap the call ran with instead.

parameter.description: The count input that was clamped.

requested.description: The value the call asked for.

nextOffset.description: Offset of the next page, for the same inputs. Absent when this page reaches the last bin.

notice.description: Guidance when no articles matched in the window — how to broaden the query or extend the window — or, when this response is one page of several, which bins it returned out of how many. When the server's local GKG mirror answered (source: gkg_mirror), why, and how its figures differ from the DOC API's. Absent when the DOC API answered and the whole histogram fit in one response.

source.description: Where this answer came from: doc_api, the GDELT DOC API, or gkg_mirror, the server's local mirror of GDELT's Global Knowledge Graph, which answers when the DOC API refuses the request or returns nothing. Present on every answer while the server runs a mirror; absent otherwise.

staleResponse.description: Present only when the refetch of this exact request was refused, failed, or came back empty, and the response is GDELT's stored answer from fetchedAt instead. It holds nothing published after fetchedAt; a relative timespan covers the window ending at fetchedAt, not now. Absent on a live answer.

ageSeconds.description: Age of the stored answer when served, in whole seconds.

fetchedAt.description: ISO 8601 time GDELT returned the stored answer.

reason.description: Why the refetch was not used: GDELT rate-limited it, did not answer with data, or answered empty — which GDELT also does under load.

summary.description: Summary statistics derived from the whole histogram, not this page. Each value is omitted when the histogram cannot support it — all of them on an empty result.

neutralPct.description: Percentage of articles in the near-neutral range (bins -2 to +2). Omitted when the histogram counts no articles.

peakNegativeBin.description: Tone bin with the highest count among negative bins (bin < 0). Omitted when no negative bin was returned.

peakPositiveBin.description: Tone bin with the highest count among positive bins (bin > 0). Omitted when no positive bin was returned.

totalCount.description: Total number of articles across all histogram bins, not only this page.

title: Get GDELT Tone Distribution
